name: local-deploy-functional-smoke
title: feat(ops): 本地部署功能冒烟脚本 + 3 个 #756/无 PG 漂移修复（票 5cq）
description: 按用户要求做本地部署后的全面功能测试，实测发现并修复 4 个真问题：1) /api/system/health 的 llm_providers 不含 magpie，#756 后 magpie 是唯一出网却报'未配置任何 LLM Provider'；2) 无 POSTGRES_URI 时 app 正常启动但 DB 池未初始化，登录直接 500 traceback，且 health 把 database 报成 ok；3) Windows GBK 控制台打印 emoji 时 CLI 崩溃（UnicodeEncodeError），xhs-growth run/version/config 全部阻断；4) CLI config 与 health 的 search_api 文案仍按 DeepSeek 直连时代写（漏列 magpie、要求 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）。修复：health 增加 magpie 与 app_db 字段、overall 需 DB 就绪才 ok；新增 DatabaseUnavailableError 并由中间件映射 503 ERROR_DB_UNAVAILABLE；CLI 启动时 reconfigure stdout/stderr 为 UTF-8；config/search 文案同步 #756。另新增 scripts/functional_smoke.py：对已部署实例做可复现冒烟（health/公开接口/静态页/鉴权边界/带凭据时的登录+工作流生命周期），无 DB 时把鉴权段标记 BLOCKED 而不是误报失败。
creator: codex
notes: DONE 2026-11-03 (user asked for a comprehensive functional test after a local deployment). Deployment reality on this machine: no podman/docker and no Postgres, so container deploy is impossible; the API was started natively (uvicorn on 8099, sqlite checkpointer, magpie gateway at 127.0.0.1:3425 reachable and verified with a real LLM call). Functional testing found six issues, five fixed here: (1) CLI crashed on a Chinese Windows GBK console — rich printing an emoji raised UnicodeEncodeError before the workflow could start; main.py now reconfigures stdout/stderr to UTF-8 with errors=replace at import. (2) Without POSTGRES_URI the server booted but the app DB pool was never initialized, so POST /api/auth/login returned 500 with a traceback; pool.get_pool now raises DatabaseUnavailableError and the middleware maps it to 503 ERROR_DB_UNAVAILABLE with a POSTGRES_URI hint. (3) /api/system/health listed only direct providers and claimed no LLM was configured while magpie worked; llm_providers now includes magpie and a magpie-specific message. (4) database health said ok for a SQLite checkpointer even though login/accounts were dead; database now carries app_db ready/unavailable and degrades overall to degraded when unavailable. (5) CLI config and search_api text still assumed direct DeepSeek; both now describe magpie/Tavily reality. (6) CLI run had no --niche and therefore could never satisfy D2' locally; --niche was added and a missing niche now exits 2 with an actionable hint instead of a traceback inside trend_scout. Added scripts/functional_smoke.py: HTTP smoke against a running instance covering health semantics (incl. magpie + app_db), public endpoints/404s, the static shell, the 401 auth boundary, and — with credentials — login, authenticated reads and an optional workflow lifecycle; a deployment without an app DB reports BLOCKED instead of failing, and only FAIL yields exit 1. Docs updated (deployment.md health semantics + smoke usage, CLAUDE.md commands/health). Measured: smoke without creds 8 pass/0 fail/1 skip; with creds 8 pass/0 fail/1 blocked (expected without Postgres); CLI version/config/run --dry-run exit 0 after the encoding fix; real CLI run --niche 家居 completed through magpie (one mid-reply retry), skipped XHS tools cleanly (no cookie), degraded Ripple, ended in planning/content_strategist with exit 0. Still unverifiable locally: the authenticated console lifecycle (needs Postgres) and container deployment (needs podman) — the smoke script covers those on a real deployment. Verification: targeted suites green, ruff, mypy, full suite in the journal.
